ios.desc:
Apple Editors’ Choice. Apple Design Award Finalist.

"Made the jump from Mint years ago and never looked back. Run, don't walk." -App Store review

"An app that I love and use." -MKBHD

Available on Web, iPhone, Mac, and iPad. 


ALL-IN-ONE MONEY APP 

Copilot Money is a personal finance app and budget planner built to help you navigate your finances with confidence. Track spending and expenses, plan budgets, and monitor investments and net worth, all in one beautifully designed app. No more spreadsheets or switching between five banking apps.
Copilot also features the Money Assistant: an AI financial assistant that sees your full financial picture and surfaces opportunities before you have to look for them. Currently available on iPhone.

Most importantly, Copilot Money is built with privacy at the center. We don’t sell your financial data, train third-party AI models on it, or show ads.
Try it free for one month!

MEET YOUR MONEY ASSISTANT (currently available on iPhone)

The Money Assistant guides you from the very first step. Once you connect your accounts, it analyzes your spending, income, and investments, then builds you a starting budget with the categories most worth tracking.
From there, it plans right alongside you, from a quick budget tweak to a decade-long goal like retirement. It can also get things done on your behalf, like recategorizing a transaction, detecting a recurring bill, or matching a refund. You just approve.

Ask it anything:
● “Where should I cut back on spending?” It flags redundancies and the categories where you’re overspending.
● “Can I cover next month’s expenses?” It checks your balances against upcoming recurring charges.
● “Am I on track to retire in 10 years?” It maps out your projected savings based on your income and contribution rate.


KEY APP FEATURES

● Cross-device sync: Access your account via Web, iPhone, Mac, and iPad.
● Money Assistant: An AI financial assistant that surfaces insights, answers questions, and takes the actions you approve in-app. Currently available on iPhone.
● All-in-one view: Connect to tens of thousands of financial institutions, including direct integrations with Venmo, Apple Card, and Coinbase.
● Auto-categorization: Copilot Intelligence handles your transactions automatically and learns your habits over time.
● Smart budgets: A budget tracker that adapts to how you actually spend.
● Subscription and bill tracking: Every recurring charge, including the ones you forgot about.
